name: OSS_T_USAGE_SERVICE_MAPPING
description: Following table be used to capture service mapping information.

columns.name: USAGE_SERVICE_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Identifies the service mapping for the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: In the context of usage service mapping, "Tracks the source object name" refers to the process of identifying and recording the specific name or identifier of the original object (or source) from which usage data is derived or mapped.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_FULL_NAME
columns.description: Tracking the "source object full name" for a given service mapping refers to the process of identifying and recording the complete, detailed name or identifier of the source object from which usage or service data is derived.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Tracks the source attribute name for given service mapping.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Tracks the source attribute data type for given service mapping.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TABLE
columns.description: Tracking the "source object table name" for a given service mapping involves identifying and recording the specific table name in a database from which data is being pulled, processed, or mapped to a particular service.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_COLUMN
columns.description: Tracks the source attribute column for given service mapping.

columns.name: TARGET_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Tracking the "target object name" for a given service mapping refers to identifying and recording the specific name of the object where data or actions are directed after being processed or mapped from a source object. This target object is the endpoint in the service mapping process, where the outcome of a service.

columns.name: TARGET_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Tracks the target attribute name for given service mapping.

columns.name: TARGET_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Tracks the target attribute data type for given service mapping.

columns.name: SERVICE_MAPPING_ELEMENT
columns.description: Tracks the service mapping element for given service mapping.

columns.name: SERVICE_MAPPING_FLAG
columns.description: Tracks the status of mapping field for given service mapping, eg.V for Valid, I for Invalid and G for Groovy.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Tracking the "event type identifier" for a given service mapping involves recording the specific identifier associated with a particular type of event or action within a system. This event type identifier helps to categorize and distinguish different types of events or actions, ensuring that they are correctly mapped to the appropriate service or process.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_DETERMINANT_ID
columns.description: Tracking the "rateplan determinant identifier" for a given service mapping involves recording the specific identifier associated with a particular type of rateplan determinant or action within a system.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
